9：獨自扶養六歲以下之直系血親卑親屬致不能工作
10：婦女懷胎六個月以上至分娩後二個月內，致不能工作；或懷胎期間經醫師診斷不宜工作

fields.description_en:
1: Age 16 or above, not a student, with work capacity

3: Under age 16, without work capacity
4: Elderly (65 or above), without work capacity
5: Age 25 or under still enrolled in Taiwan in schools other than the Open University, university-level continuing education schools, in-service programs, credit programs, schools attended only evenings or holidays, or distance-learning schools, and therefore unable to work
